description: This file contains a class definition for 'json_config' that provides methods to generate JSON configuration and metadata data used by the SuiteCRM frontend, including user info, module metadata, and specific entity data. It also includes license headers and security checks.

classes.name: json_config
classes.description: A class that generates JSON configuration, metadata, and entity data for client-side use in SuiteCRM.

methods.name: get_static_json_server
methods.description: Returns the assembled JSON string containing configuration and metadata, optionally including focus data and strings.

methods.name: getAppMetaJSON
methods.description: Generates the JSON-encoded metadata for app configuration and modules.

methods.name: getUserConfigJSON
methods.description: Creates JSON string with current user preferences and details.

methods.name: getFocusData
methods.description: Generates JSON data for a specific module and record focus, including related users and contacts.

methods.name: meeting_retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves detailed info about a Meeting, Call, or Project record and associated users and contacts.

methods.name: getStringsJSON
methods.description: Generates JSON string with localized calendar and module-specific strings.

methods.name: populateBean
methods.description: Converts an entity bean into an array suitable for JSON encoding, sanitizing fields.

methods.name: listFilter
methods.description: Filters fields based on user permissions.

methods.name: getCurrentUser
methods.description: Returns the global current user object, if set.
